steps.title: Three chart patterns on the Stocks leaderboard
steps.narration: Open the Stocks leaderboard. Until now only the VCP pattern was detected; this update adds two more — Pullback to a rising average and Flat-base breakout — and a new Pattern filter to focus the list on whichever one you want.
steps.point_out: The new 'Pattern' dropdown in the filter bar, and the small teal pattern badges (VCP, Pullback, Flat base) sitting beside a flagged name's setup status in the Setup column.

steps.title: A stock's detail explains each detected pattern
steps.narration: Click a flagged ticker to open its detail page. A name can show more than one pattern at once, and each one is laid out on its own.
steps.point_out: The Pullback and Flat base badges in the header next to the setup status, and the pattern cards below showing the plain-language reason, the breakout pivot price, and the level that would invalidate the pattern.

steps.title: The glossary documents every new pattern automatically
steps.narration: Open the Methodology glossary. Every setup and pattern is explained from the same configuration the scanner runs on, so the two new patterns document themselves with no hand-written copy.
steps.point_out: The new 'Pullback to a rising DMA' and 'Flat-base breakout' cards, each carrying a teal 'Pattern' chip, a plain-language meaning, the exact threshold numbers, and a worked example.

steps.title: Forward-tested: does each pattern actually pay off?
steps.narration: Open System Health to see the evidence. For each pattern the page compares the average forward return of names that showed it against names that didn't, so you can judge whether the pattern adds value.
steps.point_out: The two new pattern panels below the VCP one, each with a mean return and a sample size for both groups — and an honest low-sample marker instead of a made-up number when a cohort is too small.
